detailed_descriptions.en: Will you be a leader? A hero? An escape artist? With this collection of original Survivors, it’s easier than ever to find the perfect skillset to suit your playstyle. Explore and discover new perks and backstories from a roster of 12 unique characters. Includes the following characters, previously released in our Chapter add-ons: • Ace Visconti (from “Of Flesh and Mud”) • Feng Min (from “Spark of Madness”) • Kate Denson (from “Curtain Call”) • Adam Francis (from “Shattered Bloodlines”) • Jeff Johansen (from “Darkness Among Us”) • Jane Romero (from “Demise of the Faithful”) • Yui Kimura (from “Cursed Legacy”) • Zarina Kassir (from “Chains of Hate”) • Felix Richter (from “Descend Beyond”) • Élodie Rakoto (from “A Binding of Kin”) • Yun-Jin Lee (from “All-Kill”) • Mikaela Reid (from “Hour of the Witch”)

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Will you be a leader? A hero? An escape artist? With this collection of original Survivors, it’s easier than ever to find the perfect skillset to suit your playstyle. Explore and discover new perks and backstories from a roster of 12 unique characters.

Includes the following characters, previously released in our Chapter add-ons:

• Ace Visconti (from “Of Flesh and Mud”)
• Feng Min (from “Spark of Madness”)
• Kate Denson (from “Curtain Call”)
• Adam Francis (from “Shattered Bloodlines”)
• Jeff Johansen (from “Darkness Among Us”)
• Jane Romero (from “Demise of the Faithful”)
• Yui Kimura (from “Cursed Legacy”)
• Zarina Kassir (from “Chains of Hate”)
• Felix Richter (from “Descend Beyond”)
• Élodie Rakoto (from “A Binding of Kin”)
• Yun-Jin Lee (from “All-Kill”)
• Mikaela Reid (from “Hour of the Witch”)
